title: Redwire Launches European-Manufactured Space Camera and Navigation Sensor Product Line to Strengthen European Supply Chain Sovereignty
summary: Redwire today announced the launch of its Seeker product line, a family of navigation sensors and space cameras designed to meet customer demand ranging from a single spacecraft to constellation-scale…
body_markdown:
Redwire today announced the launch of its


**[Seeker product line](https://rdw.com/product-archive/sensors/seeker/)** ,


**** a family of navigation sensors and space cameras designed to meet customer demand ranging from a single spacecraft to constellation-scale missions. The Seeker product line, manufactured at Redwire’s high-volume production facility in Riga, Latvia, is intended to strengthen Europe’s satellite supply chain sovereignty and meet the growing demand across the European space sector.


The next generation of European space missions will be defined by scale, and modern satellites are expected to do more than ever before. From Earth observation constellations and communications networks to lunar infrastructure and deep-space exploration, spacecraft operators need precise, reliable components that are readily available in the quantities required to support rapidly expanding mission architectures.


Building on 50 years of manufacturing experience and flight heritage, the Seeker products include a 5MP space-rated camera, a high-accuracy star tracker, and quad sun sensor engineered to support constellation-scale production for Low Earth Orbit (LEO), Geostationary Orbit (GEO), and Lunar missions.


**Key Capabilities and Benefits**


SeekerCAM Space Camera


***SeekerCAM Space Camera***


- Delivers 5MP resolutionandruggedized imaging performance for space applications


- GigE Vision 2.0.3 compliant architecture supports streamlined integration into spacecraft systems


- Supports mission imaging, situational awareness, and spacecraft operations, bolstering critical navigation and operational decisions


***SeekerTRAC Star Tracker***


SeekerTRAC Star Tracker


- Provides high-accuracy attitude determination with cross-axis accuracy better than 5 arcseconds


- Supports update rates up to 20 Hz for responsive spacecraft guidance and control


- Expanded onboard star catalog enhances tracking capability across diverse mission profiles


- Superior low-light sensitivity enables detection of stars down to visualmagnitude8 (VM8), improving performance in challenging viewing conditions


SeekerQSS Quad Sun Sensor


***SeekerQSS Quad Sun Sensor***


- Provides two-axis solar attitude sensing across a ±65° field of view


- Delivers accuracy greater than 1.5 degrees for spacecraft orientation and safe-mode operations


- Supports reliable sun acquisition and attitude awareness for a variety of spacecraft architectures


**Why It Matters**


Built on decades of operational experience and engineered for the realities of today’s space market, Redwire’s Seeker product line provides mission-critical navigation and imaging performance while helping European customers scale faster and deploy with confidence.


**To learn more about Redwire’s Seeker and Sentinel space sensors, visit:[RDW.com](https://rdw.com/product-archive/sensors/)**
